river.title: Lockheed Martin proposes $1.8bn F-16 industrial package to Peru
river.snippet: Lockheed Martin has proposed an industrial and social partnership package for Peru, related to the F-16 Block 70 and valued at $1.8bn.

river.title: Air Force awards Boeing $131 billion ceiling contract for F-15 production, modernization
river.snippet: The Air Force has awarded Boeing a sole-source contract with a $131.23 billion ceiling to produce, modernize and sustain F-15 fighters.
